verses.original: אֹהֵ֣ב מ֭וּסָר אֹ֣הֵֽב דָּ֑עַת וְשֹׂנֵ֖א תוֹכַ֣חַת בָּֽעַר׃
verses.transliteration: ’ō·hêḇ mū·så̄r ’ō·hêḇ dā·‘aṯ wə·śō·nê ṯō·w·ḵa·ḥaṯ bā·‘ar
verses.literal: Whoever loves discipline loves knowledge but he who hates correction is stupid

verses.original: ט֗וֹב יָפִ֣יק רָ֭צוֹן מֵיְהוָ֑ה וְאִ֖ישׁ מְזִמּ֣וֹת יַרְשִֽׁיעַ׃
verses.transliteration: ṭō·wḇ yā·p̄îq rā·ṣō·wn Yah·weh wə·’îš mə·zim·mō·wṯ yar·šî·a‘
verses.literal: The good man obtains favor from the LORD but the LORD condemns a man who devises evil

verses.original: לֹא־ יִכּ֣וֹן אָדָ֣ם בְּרֶ֑שַׁע וְשֹׁ֥רֶשׁ צַ֝דִּיקִ֗ים בַּל־ יִמּֽוֹט׃
verses.transliteration: lō- yik·kō·wn ’ā·ḏām bə·re·ša‘ wə·šō·reš ṣad·dî·qîm bal- yim·mō·wṭ
verses.literal: A man cannot be established through wickedness but the righteous cannot be uprooted . . .

verses.original: אֵֽשֶׁת־ חַ֭יִל עֲטֶ֣רֶת בַּעְלָ֑הּ וּכְרָקָ֖ב בְּעַצְמוֹתָ֣יו מְבִישָֽׁה׃
verses.transliteration: ’ê·šeṯ- ḥa·yil ‘ă·ṭe·reṯ ba‘·lāh ū·ḵə·rā·qāḇ bə·‘aṣ·mō·w·ṯāw mə·ḇî·šāh
verses.literal: A wife of noble character is her husband’s crown but she who causes shame is like decay in his bones

verses.original: מַחְשְׁב֣וֹת צַדִּיקִ֣ים מִשְׁפָּ֑ט תַּחְבֻּל֖וֹת רְשָׁעִ֣ים מִרְמָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: maḥ·šə·ḇō·wṯ ṣad·dî·qîm miš·pāṭ taḥ·bu·lō·wṯ rə·šā·‘îm mir·māh
verses.literal: The plans of the righteous are just but the counsel of the wicked leads to deceit

verses.original: דִּבְרֵ֣י רְשָׁעִ֣ים אֱרָב־ דָּ֑ם וּפִ֥י יְ֝שָׁרִ֗ים יַצִּילֵֽם׃
verses.transliteration: diḇ·rê rə·šā·‘îm ’ĕ·rāḇ- dām ū·p̄î yə·šā·rîm yaṣ·ṣî·lêm
verses.literal: The words of the wicked lie in wait for blood but the speech of the upright rescues them

verses.original: הָפ֣וֹךְ רְשָׁעִ֣ים וְאֵינָ֑ם וּבֵ֖ית צַדִּיקִ֣ים יַעֲמֹֽד׃
verses.transliteration: hā·p̄ō·wḵ rə·šā·‘îm wə·’ê·nām ū·ḇêṯ ṣad·dî·qîm ya·‘ă·mōḏ
verses.literal: The wicked are overthrown and perish but the house of the righteous will stand

verses.original: לְֽפִי־ שִׂ֭כְלוֹ יְהֻלַּל־ אִ֑ישׁ וְנַעֲוֵה־ לֵ֝֗ב יִהְיֶ֥ה לָבֽוּז׃
verses.transliteration: lə·p̄î·śi- śik̲·lô yə·hul·lal- ’îš wə·na·‘ă·wêh- lêḇ yih·yeh lā·ḇūz
verses.literal: A man is praised according to his wisdom but a twisted mind is despised

verses.original: ט֣וֹב נִ֭קְלֶה וְעֶ֣בֶד ל֑וֹ מִ֝מְּתַכַּבֵּ֗ד וַחֲסַר־ לָֽחֶם׃
verses.transliteration: ṭō·wḇ niq·leh wə·‘e·ḇeḏ lōw mim·mə·ṯak·kab·bêḏ wa·ḥă·sar- lā·ḥem
verses.literal: Better to be lightly esteemed yet have a servant than to be self-important but lack food

verses.original: יוֹדֵ֣עַ צַ֭דִּיק נֶ֣פֶשׁ בְּהֶמְתּ֑וֹ וְֽרַחֲמֵ֥י רְ֝שָׁעִ֗ים אַכְזָרִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: yō·w·ḏê·a‘ ṣad·dîq ne·p̄eš bə·hem·tōw wə·ra·ḥă·mê rə·šā·‘îm ’aḵ·zā·rî
verses.literal: A righteous man regards the life of his animal but the tender mercies of the wicked are only cruelty

verses.original: עֹבֵ֣ד אַ֭דְמָתוֹ יִֽשְׂבַּֽע־ לָ֑חֶם וּמְרַדֵּ֖ף רֵיקִ֣ים חֲסַר־ לֵֽב׃
verses.transliteration: ‘ō·ḇêḏ ’aḏ·mā·ṯōw yiś·ba‘- lā·ḥem ū·mə·rad·dêp̄ rê·qîm ḥă·sar- lêḇ
verses.literal: The one who works his land will have plenty of food but whoever chases fantasies lacks judgment

verses.original: חָמַ֣ד רָ֭שָׁע מְצ֣וֹד רָעִ֑ים וְשֹׁ֖רֶשׁ צַדִּיקִ֣ים יִתֵּֽן׃
verses.transliteration: ḥā·maḏ rā·šā‘ mə·ṣō·wḏ rā·‘îm wə·šō·reš ṣad·dî·qîm yit·tên
verses.literal: The wicked desire the plunder of evil men but the root of the righteous flourishes

verses.original: בְּפֶ֣שַׁע שְׂ֭פָתַיִם מוֹקֵ֣שׁ רָ֑ע וַיֵּצֵ֖א מִצָּרָ֣ה צַדִּֽיק׃
verses.transliteration: bə·p̄e·ša‘ śə·p̲ā·t̲a·yim mō·w·qêš rā‘ way·yê·ṣê miṣ·ṣā·rāh ṣad·dîq
verses.literal: An evil man is trapped by his rebellious speech but a righteous man escapes from trouble

verses.original: מִפְּרִ֣י פִי־ אִ֭ישׁ יִשְׂבַּע־ ט֑וֹב וּגְמ֥וּל יְדֵי־ אָ֝דָ֗ם יָשׁוּב לֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: mip·pə·rî p̄î- ’îš yiś·ba‘- ṭō·wḇ ū·ḡə·mūl yə·ḏê- ’ā·ḏām yå̄·šūḇ lōw
verses.literal: By fruitful speech a man is filled with good things and the work of his hands returns to him

verses.original: דֶּ֣רֶךְ אֱ֭וִיל יָשָׁ֣ר בְּעֵינָ֑יו וְשֹׁמֵ֖עַ לְעֵצָ֣ה חָכָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: de·reḵ ’ĕ·wîl yā·šār bə·‘ê·nāw wə·šō·mê·a‘ lə·‘ê·ṣāh ḥā·ḵām
verses.literal: The way of a fool is right in his own eyes but a wise man listens to counsel

verses.original: אֱוִ֗יל בַּ֭יּוֹם יִוָּדַ֣ע כַּעְס֑וֹ וְכֹסֶ֖ה קָל֣וֹן עָרֽוּם׃
verses.transliteration: ’ĕ·wîl bay·yō·wm yiw·wā·ḏa‘ ka‘·sōw wə·ḵō·seh qā·lō·wn ‘ā·rūm
verses.literal: A fool’s anger is known at once but a prudent man overlooks an insult

verses.original: יָפִ֣יחַ אֱ֭מוּנָה יַגִּ֣יד צֶ֑דֶק וְעֵ֖ד שְׁקָרִ֣ים מִרְמָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: yā·p̄î·aḥ ’ĕ·mū·nāh yag·gîḏ ṣe·ḏeq wə·‘êḏ šə·qā·rîm mir·māh
verses.literal: He who speaks the truth declares what is right but a false witness speaks deceit

verses.original: יֵ֣שׁ בּ֭וֹטֶה כְּמַדְקְר֣וֹת חָ֑רֶב וּלְשׁ֖וֹן חֲכָמִ֣ים מַרְפֵּֽא׃
verses.transliteration: yêš bō·w·ṭeh kə·maḏ·qə·rō·wṯ ḥā·reḇ ū·lə·šō·wn ḥă·ḵā·mîm mar·pê
verses.literal: Speaking rashly is like a piercing sword but the tongue of the wise brings healing

verses.original: שְֽׂפַת־ אֱ֭מֶת תִּכּ֣וֹן לָעַ֑ד וְעַד־ אַ֝רְגִּ֗יעָה לְשׁ֣וֹן שָֽׁקֶר׃
verses.transliteration: śə·p̄aṯ- ’ĕ·meṯ tik·kō·wn lā·‘aḏ wə·‘aḏ- ’ar·gî·‘āh lə·šō·wn šā·qer
verses.literal: Truthful lips endure forever . . . but a lying tongue lasts only a moment

verses.original: מִ֭רְמָה בְּלֶב־ חֹ֣רְשֵׁי רָ֑ע וּֽלְיֹעֲצֵ֖י שָׁל֣וֹם שִׂמְחָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: mir·māh bə·leḇ- ḥō·rə·šê rā‘ ū·lə·yō·‘ă·ṣê šā·lō·wm śim·ḥāh
verses.literal: Deceit is in the hearts of those who devise evil but the counselors of peace have joy

verses.original: לֹא־ יְאֻנֶּ֣ה לַצַּדִּ֣יק כָּל־ אָ֑וֶן וּ֝רְשָׁעִ֗ים מָ֣לְאוּ רָֽע׃
verses.transliteration: lō- yə·’un·neh laṣ·ṣad·dîq kāl- ’ā·wen ū·rə·šā·‘îm mā·lə·’ū rā‘
verses.literal: No harm befalls the righteous . . . but the wicked are filled with trouble

verses.original: תּוֹעֲבַ֣ת יְ֭הוָה שִׂפְתֵי־ שָׁ֑קֶר וְעֹשֵׂ֖י אֱמוּנָ֣ה רְצוֹנֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: tō·w·‘ă·ḇaṯ Yah·weh śip̄·ṯê- šā·qer wə·‘ō·śê ’ĕ·mū·nāh rə·ṣō·w·nōw
verses.literal: Lying lips are detestable to the LORD but those who deal faithfully are His delight

verses.original: אָדָ֣ם עָ֭רוּם כֹּ֣סֶה דָּ֑עַת וְלֵ֥ב כְּ֝סִילִ֗ים יִקְרָ֥א אִוֶּֽלֶת׃
verses.transliteration: ’ā·ḏām ‘ā·rūm kō·seh dā·‘aṯ wə·lêḇ kə·sî·lîm yiq·rā ’iw·we·leṯ
verses.literal: A shrewd man keeps his knowledge to himself but a foolish heart proclaims its folly

verses.original: יַד־ חָרוּצִ֥ים תִּמְשׁ֑וֹל ו֝רְמִיָּ֗ה תִּהְיֶ֥ה לָמַֽס׃
verses.transliteration: yaḏ- ḥā·rū·ṣîm tim·šō·wl wr·mī·yå̄h tih·yeh lā·mas
verses.literal: The hand of the diligent will rule but laziness ends in forced labor

verses.original: דְּאָגָ֣ה בְלֶב־ אִ֣ישׁ יַשְׁחֶ֑נָּה וְדָבָ֖ר ט֣וֹב יְשַׂמְּחֶֽנָּה׃
verses.transliteration: də·’ā·ḡāh ḇə·leḇ- ’îš yaš·ḥen·nāh wə·ḏā·ḇār ṭō·wḇ yə·śam·mə·ḥen·nāh
verses.literal: Anxiety weighs down the heart of a man but a good word cheers it up

verses.original: יָתֵ֣ר מֵרֵעֵ֣הוּ צַדִּ֑יק וְדֶ֖רֶךְ רְשָׁעִ֣ים תַּתְעֵֽם׃
verses.transliteration: yā·ṯêr mê·rê·‘ê·hū ṣad·dîq wə·ḏe·reḵ rə·šā·‘îm taṯ·‘êm
verses.literal: A righteous man is cautious in friendship but the ways of the wicked lead them astray

verses.original: לֹא־ יַחֲרֹ֣ךְ רְמִיָּ֣ה צֵיד֑וֹ וְהוֹן־ אָדָ֖ם יָקָ֣ר חָרֽוּץ׃
verses.transliteration: lō- ya·ḥă·rōḵ rə·mî·yāh ṣê·ḏōw wə·hō·wn- ’ā·ḏām yā·qār ḥā·rūṣ
verses.literal: A lazy man does not roast his game but a diligent man prizes his possession

verses.original: בְּאֹֽרַח־ צְדָקָ֥ה חַיִּ֑ים וְדֶ֖רֶךְ נְתִיבָ֣ה אַל־ מָֽוֶת׃
verses.transliteration: bə·’ō·raḥ- ṣə·ḏā·qāh ḥay·yîm wə·ḏe·reḵ nə·ṯî·ḇāh ’al- må̄·wɛṯ
verses.literal: There is life in the path of righteousness but another path . . . . . . leads to death
